name: NSF NEON National Ecological Observatory Network Open Data
description: The National Ecological Observatory Network (NEON), funded by the National Science Foundation and operated by Battelle, is a continental-scale ecological observation facility designed to collect standardized ecological data across 81 field sites (47 terrestrial, 34 aquatic) in 20 ecoclimatic domains across the United States. NEON delivers 180+ standardized open data products combining automated sensor telemetry (flux towers, eddy covariance, soil arrays, stream gauges), airborne remote sensing (hyperspectral, LiDAR, RGB), and observational field sampling (plants, insects, microbes, mammals).
